name: surplace
description: SURPLACE — application de taxi-moto à Korhogo

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev:https --prefix Frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix Backend" "npm start --prefix Frontend"
